title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(島内末廣研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Shimauchi Suehiro)
keywords: Acoustic signal processing 2.Adaptive control 3.Machine learning 4.Mathematical and physical modeling 5.Local cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will develop the following abilities required for engineers in electrical and electronic fields: (1) Ability for problem discovery and problem solving. (2) Ability for analyzing experimental results. (3) Ability for logical thinking. (4) Communication skills.
advice: This is the final course in the Design Project Program. In this course, each student will be involved in a research project. The laboratory provides several research themes related to: 1. Signal processing for microphone sensing 2. Signal processing for sound reproduction 3. Audio system control 4. Acoustic signal analysis Students are required to present the project plans and achievements through documentation and oral presentations.
requiredKnowledge: Mathematical and software programming skills to handle digital signal processing problems. English language skills to catch the latest research trends. Humble and greedy attitude towards unknown or unsolved things.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clarify a project purpose and make a research plan.
Be able to define and perform tasks to solve problems.
Be able to correctly analyze and evaluate research results, taking into account social demands and trends.
Be able to present and discuss research results effectively.
Be able to logically write research results as project reports.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Describe details of the project theme, based on understanding of significance, purpose and future social contributions of the project theme. (2) Explain how the project results can be applied to related fields by specifying requirements. (3) Build experimental systems, implement software, and develop prototypes for the project. (4) Effectively present research results at the final presentation and answer questions (5) Complete the project plan to the end and achieve high results recognized for academic or social contributions.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Describe outline of the project and point out its challenges, based on understanding of significance and purpose of the project theme. (2) Explain how the project results can be applied to related fields. (3) Build experimental systems and implement software for the project. (4) Effectively present research results at the final presentation and answer questions. (5) Complete the project plan to the end.

lessons.content: Research projects directed by the professional supervisor
